title: 前沿模型开放使用：安全事件责任谁担，市场能否消化担忧？
speaker: Sunny Bagnia

segments.en: so suddenly we've had a few hours to sort of dissect market reaction I guess to a part question does the reaction make sense and how do you think the story evolves throughout the course of this week
segments.zh: 我们刚刚有几个小时来消化市场反应，先问一个核心问题：这个反应合理吗？以及你认为这周故事会如何演变？

segments.en: yeah it's a very fascinating events essentially frenemies now all these AI labs and and and the thing is that it obviously does you know raise fees about whether this leads to a broader AI cap X lowdown
segments.zh: 是的，这是非常引人注目的事件，这些AI实验室现在亦敌亦友。这确实引发了对更广泛的AI资本开支是否放缓的担忧。

segments.en: all that's really been discussed is the safety concerns around the frontier models where capability is really pushing to new boundaries and over the last few weeks we've seen you know interesting cybersecurity instances that have come come to fruition
segments.zh: 讨论的核心是前沿模型的安全担忧，模型能力正不断推向新边界。过去几周我们看到了一些值得关注的网络安全事件。

segments.en: and I think that's probably what's more our play here who's liable if if these models are released for more general purpose use and the lead to more cybersecurity event so I think these labs are going to work on safeguarding the security element but perhaps not so much as in slowing down the development of these models
segments.zh: 我认为这才是更关键的问题：如果这些模型被更广泛地开放使用并引发更多网络安全事件，谁来负责？所以这些实验室会加强安全保障，但可能不会因此放缓模型开发。

segments.en: at the at the end of the day these companies will go public when an anthropic is looking to go public it's posted its second quarter of profitability ultimately the profitability is going to be fact that these models are very capable and are generating you you know useful AI for enterprise so their adoption will continue to grow
segments.zh: 归根结底，这些公司会走向公开市场。Anthropic在寻求公开上市时已公布第二季度盈利。盈利能力最终取决于这些模型非常强大，能为企业生成有用的AI，因此采用率会继续增长。

segments.en: so I think it's sort of the market now just digesting these fears and then trying to look past what what the longer term outlook for AI cap X is
segments.zh: 所以我认为市场现在只是在消化这些担忧，然后试图超越短期，看向AI资本开支的长期前景。
